purpose.domain_detail: CICS online program acting as a controller/gateway that calls a z/OS Connect EE (API Connect) REST API stub (cicsrs_1.0.0) to retrieve CICS resource/transaction information
purpose.summary: VSRSMAIN is a CICS online program that receives a transaction request, extracts a store/structure name from the COMMAREA, and invokes a z/OS Connect EE generated API stub (BAQ) to POST to the cicsrs REST API endpoint for CICS parameter/transaction data. It handles OAuth and token-based authentication structures generated by DFHJS2LS. The program appears to be a catalog or resource-query controller derived from the IBM CICS TS sample application DFH0XCMN.
